summary: Applied 3 spec review repairs for scope filtering, registry post-hook behavior, and task-scoped review compatibility.

items.title: Scope filtering can discard required blocking findings
items.rationale: Updated the structured finding contract and scope filtering rules so missing-acceptance blockers may use `requirementId` and remain blocking without a file path.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R1 and R13, data_flow[1], acceptance_criteria[3], and clarifications[5] now define the missing-acceptance blocker exception.

items.title: Impl review FAIL transition omits the registry post hook
items.rationale: Added registry.js as a transition owner and required the review post hook to consume structured verdicts so FAIL cannot promote gate-impl.
items.evidence: spec.json modules, data_flow, requirement R15, acceptance criteria, implementationTargets, and T-2 now cover registry post-hook behavior.

items.title: Task-scoped impl review compatibility is unspecified
items.rationale: Added task-scoped review to the structured contract and required task prompt wording to match flow-level impl review policy.
items.evidence: spec.json modules, decisions, requirements R16/R17, clarifications, implementationTargets, and T-3 now cover `--task-spec` and `src/flow/prompts/task/review.md`.
